headline:
A strong foundation.
A brighter next chapter.
intro: Supporting the next chapter in education for Fox Chapel Golf Club employees, children of employees, and caddies.
welcome: Through the generosity of Club members, the Foundation helps eligible members of our Club community pursue post-secondary education. Scholarships are awarded for one year, and eligible applicants may reapply in later years.
eligibility: For employees, children of employees, and caddies of Fox Chapel Golf Club.
Tell us the qualified school or college you plan to attend in Fall {year}.
Complete the six application sections and include the required supporting documents.
requirements: A recommendation letter from someone outside Fox Chapel Golf Club; include their name and relationship. Letters from FCGC personnel do not qualify.
A personal essay of 1–2 pages about your educational and occupational goals and how this scholarship would help.
The first two pages of your FAFSA summary, if submitted. Explain if you did not submit FAFSA.
Your school’s financial aid estimate for one full academic year. Explain pending aid or missing documents.
Full-year tuition and required fees, housing and food, miscellaneous costs, and scholarships or grants.
Student signature; parent or guardian signature if the student is under 18.
